description.value: The Revelstoke Dam Visitor Centre, operated by BC Hydro, sits at the base of the Revelstoke Dam on the Columbia River and offers guided and self-guided exploration of one of BC's major hydroelectric facilities. The centre is a seasonal stop that gives visitors a striking close-up view of the dam's massive concrete structure and the reservoir above. For touring cyclists passing through the Revelstoke area, it represents a distinctive engineering landmark well off the usual commercial strip.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record confirms this is a real, seasonal BC Hydro-operated tourist facility with a verified URL and phone number. The fetched website content, however, consists almost entirely of BC Hydro's global navigation menus with no visitor-centre-specific body text visible, so no cycling amenities can be confirmed from the website. All required and optional amenity fields default to null; the OSM wheelchair=yes tag is noted but not used as authoritative evidence for washrooms per the rules.
concerns: Website content block contains only BC Hydro global navigation menus; no visitor-centre-specific body text was captured, making amenity verification impossible from this fetch.
OSM wheelchair=yes tag suggests accessible facilities may exist but cannot be used as authoritative evidence for washrooms without website corroboration.
Facility is seasonal (May–September per OSM); directory listing should reflect seasonal availability.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The venue is a legitimate and notable tourist attraction suitable for the directory, but the website fetch returned only global navigation with no facility-specific content, leaving all cyclist amenities unverifiable. A manual check of the page or a direct call to the centre is needed to confirm at least washrooms and bike parking before publishing.
enrichment_extras.notes: BC Hydro contact email from OSM: revelstoke@bchydro.com. A direct inquiry or in-person visit would efficiently resolve the missing amenity fields.
